actions.description: Associate a content type with a SharePoint list.
actions.name: add-content-type-to-list

siteId.description: SharePoint site ID. Example: "hostname, guid1, guid2"

contentTypeId.description: Content type ID to add. Provide this or contentTypeUrl. Example: "0x0100D7B64D4E96D446B8B27A7FB63C94B3E2"

contentTypeUrl.description: Full content type URL to add. Provide this or contentTypeId. Example: "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/{siteId}/contentTypes/{contentTypeId}"

actions.description: Invite users or groups to access a drive item.
actions.name: add-drive-item-permission

email.description: The email address for the recipient.

alias.description: The alias of the domain object.

objectId.description: The unique identifier for the recipient in the directory.

message.description: Optional message included in the sharing invitation.

requireSignIn.description: Whether the recipient must sign in.

sendInvitation.description: Whether to send a sharing invitation notification.

actions.description: Copy a file or folder to another location in a site drive.
actions.name: copy-drive-item

parentItemId.description: Destination parent folder item ID. Example: "01RFYLAYF6Y2GOVW7725BZO354PWSELRRZ"

name.description: Optional new name for the copy. Example: "nango-copy-test-copy.txt"

childrenOnly.description: If true, only copy children of a folder.

includeAllVersionHistory.description: If true, preserve all version history.

actions.description: Create a content type on a SharePoint site.
actions.name: create-content-type

group.description: Group name for the content type.

base.description: Base content type reference. Defaults to Item (0x01) if omitted.

id.description: Base content type ID. Example: "0x01" for Item, "0x0101" for Document.

actions.description: Create a folder in a SharePoint document library.
actions.name: create-drive-folder

parentItemId.description: Parent item ID where the folder will be created. Example: "0123456789abcdef"

name.description: Name of the new folder. Example: "New Folder"

conflictBehavior.description: Conflict behavior if a folder with the same name exists. Defaults to "rename".

actions.description: Start a large file upload session in a site drive.
actions.name: create-drive-upload-session

fileName.description: Name of the file to upload. Example: "document.pdf"

conflictBehavior.description: Conflict behavior if the file already exists. Default: "fail"

deferCommit.description: If true, the final creation requires an explicit completion request. Default: false

fileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes. Only available for OneDrive personal.

description.description: Description of the file. Only available for OneDrive personal.

actions.description: Create a column on a SharePoint list.
actions.name: create-list-column

name.description: API-facing name of the column. Example: "TestColumn"

displayName.description: User-facing name of the column. Example: "Test Column"

enforceUniqueValues.description: Whether column values must be unique.

hidden.description: Whether the column is hidden in the UI.

indexed.description: Whether the column is indexed for search and sort.

required.description: Whether the column value is required.

readOnly.description: Whether the column values can be modified.

columnGroup.description: Group name for organizing site columns.

validation.description: Validation formula and message for the column.

actions.description: Create an item in a SharePoint list.

fields.description: Field values that match the list schema.
